children: Render's first voting round on RNP-024 opens on October 27, 2026, at 5 p.m. Pacific time and closes on October 30 at the same time. The proposal would introduce Forth as a gateway for private access to AI models. A snapshot takes place shortly before voting opens. RENDER held in self-custodial wallets qualifies for voting.
Approval could change RENDER's utility and value capture by bringing private AI model access into the Render ecosystem.

First round of voting begins Tuesday Oct 27th, 5pm Pacific time, for RNP-024, which introduces Forth to the Render Network ecosystem as a gateway to privately access AI models. A snapshot will be taken shortly before.

title: Render: RNP-024 vote opens on Forth's private AI gateway - 27 Oct 2026 to 30 Oct 2026
